Post Date: 2019-03-26T20:38:43Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: lambda environments wont reupdate if you delete one of them in lambda console.
Description: 
- What went wrong?
I cannot reupdate environments variables if you previosly delete one of them in AWS lambda console. It seems if you modify the environments directly in the console, CloudFormation cannot detect any change in the CloudFormation stack template so nothing is happen if you deploy again the function.

- How to reproduce?
Deploy a project(pyton 2.7) with some environments variables.  Then go to aws lambda console and delete it directly and save the function. Now try to deploy the project again (sls deploy -s test for example) and you will see your environments does not upload anymore.
